cases.sentence: Пускай ___ свой по воде, ведь после многих дней ты вновь найдешь его.
cases.explain: Nominative for subject of the imperative verb.

cases.sentence: Раздели то, что ты имеешь, на семь или даже восемь ___.
cases.explain: Genitive plural is used after numerals greater than four.

cases.sentence: Если тучи полны воды, то они прольют дождь на ___.
cases.explain: Accusative after 'на' when indicating motion or direction.

cases.sentence: Если ___ упадет на юг или на север, то куда оно упадет, там и останется.
cases.explain: Nominative for the subject of the verb 'упадет' (falls).

cases.sentence: Как не знаешь ___ ветра и того, как ребенок формируется в утробе матери.
cases.explain: Genitive object after the negative verb 'не знаешь' (do not know).

cases.sentence: Сладок ___, и приятно для глаз видеть солнце.
cases.explain: Nominative for the predicate subject after 'сладок' (is sweet).

cases.sentence: Сколько бы ___ ни жил человек, пусть всегда веселится.
cases.explain: Genitive plural after the indefinite temporal expression with 'сколько' (how many).

cases.sentence: Но пусть помнит о ___ тьмы, ведь их будет много.

reading.ru: Пускай хлеб свой по воде, ведь после многих дней ты вновь найдешь его.
reading.question: What does the text say should happen to bread cast on water?
options: You will find it again after many days
reading.correct: You will find it again after many days
reading.explain: The verse states that bread cast on water will be found again after many days.

reading.ru: Кто наблюдает за ветром, никогда не посеет.
reading.question: According to the text, what will never happen to those who watch the wind?
options: They will never reap a harvest
reading.explain: The text explicitly states that those who observe the wind will never sow.

reading.ru: Как не знаешь путей ветра и того, как ребенок формируется в утробе матери, Так же не можешь постигнуть дел Бога, создателя своего.
reading.question: Why does the text say humans cannot understand God's works?
options: God hides the truth from people
Just as we don't know the ways of wind or how a child forms in the womb, we can't understand God's works
reading.correct: Just as we don't know the ways of wind or how a child forms in the womb, we can't understand God's works
reading.explain: The passage uses the analogy of not understanding the ways of wind and fetal development to explain why we cannot comprehend God's works.

reading.ru: Веселись, юноша, пока молодой, и пусть твое сердце радуется в дни юности твоей.
reading.question: What does the text tell a young person to do?
options: Rejoice while young and let your heart be glad in your youth
reading.correct: Rejoice while young and let your heart be glad in your youth
reading.explain: The verse directly instructs youth to rejoice and let their hearts be glad during their youthful days.

reading.ru: Но пусть помнит о днях тьмы, ведь их будет много.
reading.question: What should people remember according to this verse?
options: To remember the days of darkness, for there will be many
reading.correct: To remember the days of darkness, for there will be many
reading.explain: The text explicitly instructs people to remember the days of darkness and notes that these days will be numerous.

reading.ru: Итак, гони беспокойство из сердца твоего и удаляй страдания от тела твоего, потому что детство и юность — суета.
reading.question: What does the text advise people to do with worry and suffering?
options: Embrace them as part of life
Drive worry from your heart and suffering from your body
reading.correct: Drive worry from your heart and suffering from your body
reading.explain: The verse instructs to remove worry from the heart and suffering from the body.
